# Divina Nail Lounge

> Boutique nail lounge based in Round Rock, Texas. Gel manicures, acrylic and Gel-X sets, hand-painted nail art and CBD Volcanic pedicures in a spotless, flower-filled lounge on N Mays St in Round Rock.

- Phone: (833) 585-2144
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Georgetown, Pflugerville, Hutto, Cedar Park, Austin
- Google rating: 5.0 from 38 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/divina-nail-lounge/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/divina-nail-lounge/book.html

## Services
- Nail art & bling: Three art levels from $10: French tips, chrome and cat eye up to hand-painted characters, 3D sculpted flowers and heavy bling.
- Gel manicures: Gel polish manicures from $40 that wear two to three weeks, plus the Reyna Manicure Experience with scrub, mask, massage and gel shine.
- Acrylic sets & fills: Acrylic sets from XS to XXL starting at $45, fills every two to two and a half weeks, and rebalances for grown-out sets.
- Builder gel & Gel-X: Builder gel to strengthen your natural nails while they grow, or lightweight Gel-X extensions that soak off easily.
- Pedicures: From the Simply Clean Pedi to the CBD Volcanic Deluxe with hot stones and paraffin, or the Rose Milk Foot Bath, in cognac leather chairs.
- Waxing: Brows, upper lip, full face and underarm waxing you can add to any nail or pedicure visit.

## About
Divina Nail Lounge is in Suite 200 at 2021 N Mays St in Round Rock. Walk in and you'll see why people call it a beautiful salon: a black coffered ceiling, cognac leather pedicure chairs with rust throws, brass faucets, little sugar skulls on the side tables, and a line-drawn face on the wall crowned in magenta and orange bougainvillea. Four nail techs work here: Susana (Susie), Lexi, Anay and Yadi. Clients say they take their time, explain each step, give real nail-care advice and do exactly the design you ask for, from a classic French to a World Cup set to support Mexico. Some guests get a mimosa while their pedicure starts. And it's clean. Reviewers notice the ventilation and the sanitation standards, and say they never smell the acrylic. Moms bring their daughters, brides come in before the wedding, and some clients bring their whole office.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 10 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., Saturday and Sunday 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Closed Mondays. Holiday hours are posted on Google.
- Q: Where are you located?
  A: Suite 200 at 2021 N Mays St, Round Rock, TX 78664.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Booking ahead is the best way to get your favorite tech and time. Book online or call (833) 585-2144. Please give at least 10 hours notice to cancel or reschedule.
- Q: How much is nail art?
  A: Level 1 art (French, chrome, simple ombré, one accent nail) is $10 to $15, Level 2 (marble, animal print, aura, detailed French) is $20 to $25, and Level 3 (a different hand-painted design on every nail, 3D gel, charms) is $30 to $40.
- Q: What if my polish chips?
  A: Our 7-day polish guarantee covers gel or regular polish that chips, peels or lifts within 7 days from normal wear. Contact us and we'll repair it at no charge.
- Q: Do you do kids' nails?
  A: Yes: the Princess Mani and the Princess or Prince Pedi for ages 3 to 12, and a short Mini Acrylic Set for ages 8 to 14 with parental consent at check-in.
